data.title: Albemarle Earns Hold as Strong Specialties Offset Lithium Uncertainty; $189 Price Target Reaffirmed
data.description:
Morgan Stanley analyst Vincent Andrews has maintained their neutral stance on ALB stock, giving a Hold rating yesterday.

Claim 55% Off TipRanks

  • Unlock powerful investing tools with TipRanks Premium to make smarter, more confident investment decisions
  • Subscribe to TipRanks Smart Investor Newsletter, and discover new investing opportunities with data-backed stock picks

Vincent Andrews has given his Hold rating due to a combination of factors, balancing strong recent execution against lingering medium-term uncertainties. Albemarle delivered a clear earnings beat, driven largely by outperformance in its Specialties segment and solid free cash flow, and management raised long-term guidance for that division while reaffirming its broader 2026 scenarios. However, the durability of this Specialty strength is not yet proven beyond the next couple of years, and management is already signaling sequential moderation from second-quarter levels.

On the lithium side, results only modestly exceeded expectations, and investor sentiment remains heavily influenced by the recent downtrend in lithium prices and questions about future pricing levels. The company’s updated outlook also includes slightly lower projected Energy Storage volumes and acknowledges that some current margin tailwinds and cash benefits are temporary. With the price target left unchanged at $189, the stock’s risk/reward profile appears balanced, leading Andrews to maintain a neutral, or Hold, stance pending clearer visibility on long-term lithium pricing and volume growth.

According to TipRanks, Andrews is a 3-star analyst with an average return of 2.6% and a 62.06% success rate. Andrews covers the Basic Materials sector, focusing on stocks such as Corteva, Chemours Company, and Mosaic Co.
